snippet.title: UTOPIUM  Launch Trailer - indie top-down brawler about avenging a pigeon
snippet.description:
Utopium is a northern top-down indie brawler. Take the spirit hammer and smash the souls out of your enemies as you rampage through a world-spanning dystopian factory to overthrow its CEO and avenge your pet pigeon. 

You can play it as a pure action game about hitting people with a hammer, and if you’re interested there's a deep well of lore and philosophy about what technology is doing to the human spirit The story is told over a linear campaign that you can finish in a few hours, featuring regional British accents and oddball dark humour. Unlock three unique abilities for a different fighting style with every playthrough, and enter the flow state with four endless survival mode
levels.
